title: Inside the Pipeline
theme: A short demo of the render pipeline

titles: Swap the pack, keep the pipeline
publish.content: A short demo of the FrameFlow pipeline. Script data goes in; a timed video, subtitles, a transcript and publish copy come out. The renderer never hardcodes a topic.
publish.cta: Star the repo and try your own content pack

lines.text: Every video starts as a single text file
Scene count, duration and aspect ratio are config
The renderer only reads that data
Nothing about the topic is baked into the code
Replace the content pack, keep every line of code
Fonts, audio and artwork come from the pack
Optional visual modules are switched on in config
Bring your own script and press render
